title: Storm Ledgics Review 2026: Risk Check
description: Thinking of signing up with Storm Ledgics? Its page lists stocks trading, credit card deposits and a $250 minimum, but names no regulator or licence.
author: Sophia Reynolds
excerpt: The page asks "scam or safe?" without answering.
content:
The page asks "scam or safe?" without answering. It offers stock trading paid by credit card with no named licence or operator. Outside verification was not run.

What the page says

  • Platform type: online trading platform
  • Technology: smart algorithms
  • Minimum deposit: min $250
  • Asset class: stocks
  • Payment methods: credit cards
  • Withdrawal: withdrawal up to 24h
  • Registration fee: no registration fee
  • Support: all-day support

What we could not check

We have not run regulator or security-database checks on this platform for this review. The page does not name a regulator, licence or company.
